build_cubify_mesh: build a python module to convert voxel occupancy tensors into 3D meshes using cubify with a threshold
create_unravel_index: create a function that converts flat indices into 4D (N, H, W, D) multi-dimensional indices
create_ravel_index: create a function that converts 3D (H, W, D) multi-dimensional indices into flat linear indices
test_cubify_align_modes: test the cubify function with topleft, corner, and center alignment modes on sample voxels
refactor_cubify_threshold: refactor the cubify function to support per-voxel dynamic thresholds instead of a single scalar
